answer_2.quote: To measure the performance of our misinformation detection approaches in hard classification settings we mainly report accuracy and weighted F1 score.

answer_4.quote: We performed a small sample, preliminary evaluation where an author checked each explanation for reasonableness.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation used two criteria: GT-Reasonable (if the explanation is reasonable in relation to the ground truth) and Score-Reasonable (if the explanation is reasonable in relation to the score it gives).
